main_body: autumn tree with canopy and trunk
top_band: upper lit orange-red canopy crown rows 1-14 above shaded under-canopy and lower puffs
evidence: The tree canopy has a distinct top-lit crown (rows 1-14) overhanging a shaded lower canopy and front puff (rows 15-28), which in turn overhangs a recessed vertical trunk (rows 29-44) with an eave shadow at row 28-29.

style.evidence: While the canopy has 5 orange/red steps, its blobs are blocky and noisy compared to the finely clustered leaf tufts of the Beodeul references. More importantly, the trunk is a completely straight, rigid vertical rectangle (rows 28-44) enclosed in a thick near-black outline with a repetitive diagonal stripe pattern and flat base, lacking the organic flared roots, bark texture, and colored outlines of the reference trees.
